subject.title: feat(ios): improve onboarding gateway connection flow

question: Should this PR's Tailscale/MagicDNS connection chooser be adopted into the current post-refresh iOS onboarding flow?
rationale: The feature is useful and proven, but it overlaps a newer merged onboarding design and touches first-run gateway security behavior, so automation should not choose the final UX/security direction.

options.title: Adopt after rebase
options.body: Rebase the Tailscale/MagicDNS path onto current main, preserve current onboarding contracts, and fix the typography finding before merge.

options.title: Narrow to security/auth copy
options.body: Keep only the raw 100.x block and password-missing recovery pieces if the full chooser no longer fits the refreshed onboarding design.

options.title: Close as superseded UX
options.body: Close this PR if maintainers decide the merged onboarding refresh should remain the sole first-run connection design for now.

recommendation.title: Adopt after rebase
recommendation.body: Rebase the Tailscale/MagicDNS path onto current main, preserve current onboarding contracts, and fix the typography finding before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership of the iOS onboarding and typography guard makes this the best available routing candidate.
